market: Global Underfill and Die-Attach Adhesives Market
market_definition: The underfill and die-attach adhesives market comprises precision adhesives used to bond semiconductor dies to substrates and to fill gaps beneath flip-chip and BGA packages. It measures sales of capillary, no-flow and film-type underfill and die-attach pastes and films. BY PRODUCT TYPE: Capillary Underfill, No-Flow / Pre-Applied Underfill, Die-Attach Pastes, Die-Attach Films. BY CHEMISTRY: Epoxy, Silicone, Polyimide / Other. BY FILLER: Conductive, Non-Conductive. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Consumer Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Telecom & Data Centers, Industrial & Power Semiconductors, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Electrically conductive adhesives for general interconnect; solder and sintering pastes; encapsulants and potting compounds; semiconductor wafers and equipment. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
